summary: Completed backend and frontend validation for admin-only full bank delete in /deposits and /reconciliations, cascade deletion behavior, and setup.exe MZ signature.
action_items: No blocking fixes required for requested scope.
Optional cleanup: remove leftover TEST bank/user generated by the first failed UI attempt (test-ui-delete-bank-1777231629, ui_delete_scope_1777231629).
critical_code_review_comments: No critical functional bug found in requested delete-bank scope.
backend/server.py remains a large monolithic file (>1200 lines), increasing regression risk and making targeted changes harder to validate.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST banks, deposits, reconciliations, and temporary non-admin users (ui_delete_scope_*). One TEST bank/user pair from a failed automation attempt may remain and is listed in action_items.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on https://scanner-ocr-test.preview.emergentagent.com. API checks confirmed non-admin DELETE /api/admin/banks/{id} returns 403, admin delete returns deleted_deposits/deleted_reconciliations counts and removes bank from /api/banks. UI checks confirmed admin sees delete buttons in both /deposits and /reconciliations, deleting TEST bank from /deposits removes it from both pages, and non-admin sees zero delete buttons on both pages.
rca of the issue: No product bug reproduced in requested scope. One automation script failure was due to test assumption mismatch: admin login redirected to /secure-admin-control-panel (requires_2fa_setup flow) instead of module page. Updating script to navigate directly to /deposits after login resolved the test harness issue.
